passages.text:
Hi Lan,
Guess what? Last month I took up a new hobby: drawing comics! I used to watch cartoons every evening, but now I spend my spare time on my own stories. My first comic is about a cat who travels to the moon. It isn't finished yet, because I only draw at weekends. Can I show it to you on Saturday?
Mai

Every year before Tết, Hà's whole family meets at her grandmother's house to make bánh chưng. Her grandmother never uses a recipe book; she has made the cakes so many times that she knows every step by heart. The ingredients are simple: sticky rice, green beans, pork and special leaves. Wrapping the cakes neatly, however, is not easy, and Hà's first cakes always fell apart. Last year her grandmother finally let her wrap a few on her own. They did not look perfect, but the flavour was just right. For Hà, the best part of the custom is not eating the cakes but spending a whole day in one kitchen with three generations of her family.

For decades, many people believed the popular theory that we use only ten per cent of our brains. The idea appeared in magazines, films and even advertisements for 'brain training' games. However, when scientists began to carry out research with modern scanners, they found no evidence to support it. Their images showed that almost every part of the brain is active during a normal day, even while we are asleep. Moreover, damage to almost any small area can cause serious problems, which would not happen if most of the brain were unused. So why does the myth survive? Researchers suggest that its message is simply attractive: it tells us that we all have hidden talents waiting to be discovered. The truth, as one researcher put it, is less exciting but far more useful.

items.q: Câu 16 trong đề gốc
items.explain_vi: ==other classes ... can't do their work if you shout at one another== → **B (bớt ồn)**. __Mẹo:__ cô không giục làm nhanh hay bảo giúp nhau.

items.q: Câu 17 trong đề gốc
items.explain_vi: ==We've done so much exercise today!== → **C (chơi thể thao)**. __Mẹo:__ ăn pizza, nghe nhạc là việc sắp làm, chưa làm.

items.q: Câu 18 trong đề gốc
items.explain_vi: ==exercise two on page six, not page sixteen!== → **B (làm nhầm bài)**. __Mẹo:__ Sarah không làm sai nhiều hay quên bài.

items.q: Câu 19 trong đề gốc
items.explain_vi: ==the only one in the shop that was big enough== → **A (kích cỡ vừa)**. __Mẹo:__ màu không như Lara muốn, giá thì đắt.

items.q: Câu 20 trong đề gốc
items.explain_vi: ==take an umbrella because it's just starting to rain== → **B (trời mưa)**. __Mẹo:__ trời ấm hơn hôm qua nên không lạnh.

items.q: Be quiet, please! The baby ______ in the next room.
items.explain_vi: Có ==Be quiet, please!== → việc đang diễn ra lúc nói → **is sleeping** (hiện tại tiếp diễn). __Mẹo: Look!, Listen!, Be quiet! báo hiệu thì tiếp diễn.__

items.q: Nam ______ his bike to school when he fell off and hurt his knee.
items.explain_vi: Có ==when he fell off== → việc đang diễn ra dùng **was riding**. __Việc dài: was/were + V-ing; việc xen vào: quá khứ đơn.__

items.q: My grandparents ______ in this village since 1990.
items.explain_vi: Có ==since 1990== → bắt đầu trong quá khứ, nay vẫn còn → **have lived** (hiện tại hoàn thành). __Nhớ: since + mốc, for + khoảng thời gian.__

items.q:
A: I can't open this jar. The lid is too tight.
B: ______
options: Give it to me. I'll open it for you.
Give it to me. I opened it for you.
Give it to me. I open it for you.
Give it to me. I've opened it for you.
items.explain_vi: B quyết định giúp ngay lúc nói → **will: I'll open it for you**. Dấu hiệu ==I can't open this jar==. __Đề nghị giúp, quyết định tức thì → will + V.__

items.q: We have a maths test on Friday, so I need to ______ tonight.
items.explain_vi: Có ==a maths test on Friday== → tối nay phải ôn bài: **revise**. __attend, encourage cần tân ngữ; improve không hợp nghĩa.__

items.q: Don't ______ that glass jar. We can use it again for our pencils.
items.explain_vi: Có ==We can use it again== → đừng vứt đi: **throw away**. __cut down: cắt giảm; give up: từ bỏ; take up: bắt đầu sở thích.__

items.q: In July, my family visited Hội An. On the last day, I bought a small lantern as a ______ for my best friend. She loved it!
items.explain_vi: Món đồ ==bought ... for my best friend== sau chuyến đi → **souvenir** (quà lưu niệm). __passenger: hành khách; journey: chuyến đi; delay: sự chậm trễ.__

items.q: The map you gave us was really ______, and we didn't get lost. (HELP)
items.explain_vi: Sau ==really== cần **tính từ**; ==we didn't get lost== → nghĩa tích cực: help + -ful → **helpful**. __-ful = có, -less = không có.__

items.q: What did Mai use to do in the evenings?
items.explain_vi: Bài đọc: ==I used to watch cartoons every evening== → **watch cartoons**. __used to = thói quen cũ, nay không còn; vẽ truyện là sở thích mới.__

items.q: Why isn't Mai's comic finished yet?
options: She is too busy with homework.
items.explain_vi: Bài đọc: ==It isn't finished yet, because I only draw at weekends== → **She only draws at weekends**. __Câu hỏi Why → tìm 'because'.__

items.q: At our school, you ______ wear a uniform on Fridays, but you can if you want to.
items.explain_vi: Có ==but you can if you want to== → không bắt buộc: **don't have to**. __Bẫy: mustn't = cấm, khác hẳn don't have to = không cần.__

items.q: The first email was sent in 1971, and today millions of emails are send every second.
items.explain_vi: Bị động cần **be + V3**: ==are send== sửa thành **are sent**. __'was sent' đã đúng; nhìn kỹ dạng động từ sau be.__

items.q: There's only ______ milk left in the fridge, so we can't make pancakes.
items.explain_vi: ==milk== không đếm được → **a little**. __a few, many, few chỉ đi với danh từ đếm được số nhiều.__

items.q: If you ______ this button, the lights will switch off.
items.explain_vi: Điều kiện loại 1: vế chính có ==will switch off== → vế If dùng hiện tại đơn: **press**. __Không dùng will trong mệnh đề If.__

items.q: In many Vietnamese families, it is a CUSTOM to visit relatives on the first day of Tết.
items.explain_vi: **custom** (phong tục) **≈ tradition** (truyền thống). ==visit relatives on the first day of Tết== là việc làm từ lâu đời. __festival là lễ hội.__

items.q: Mr Nam is very GENEROUS. He often gives food to poor families in our street.
items.explain_vi: **generous** (hào phóng) >< **mean** (keo kiệt). ==gives food to poor families== cho thấy nghĩa hào phóng. __kind gần nghĩa, đừng chọn nhầm.__

items.q: Technology changes so quickly that it's hard to ______ all the new apps.
items.explain_vi: Có ==changes so quickly== → khó theo kịp: **keep up with**. __switch off: tắt; drop out of: bỏ ngang; set off: khởi hành.__

items.q: Everyone clapped loudly at the end of the band's ______. (PERFORM)
items.explain_vi: Sau sở hữu cách ==the band's== cần **danh từ**: perform + -ance → **performance**. __Sau 's hoặc my/his/their là danh từ.__

items.q: Why doesn't Hà's grandmother use a recipe book?
options: She has lost her old book.
She knows every step from memory.
The recipe is too simple to write down.
Hà reads the recipe to her.
items.explain_vi: Bài đọc: ==she knows every step by heart== → **She knows every step from memory**. __by heart = thuộc lòng; đáp án thường diễn đạt lại bằng từ khác.__

items.q: What does Hà enjoy most about the custom?
options: wrapping the cakes on her own
spending the day with her family
items.explain_vi: Bài đọc: ==not eating the cakes but spending a whole day … with three generations== → **spending the day with her family**. __'not A but B': ý chính là B.__

items.q: My grandmother is a retired teacher. Her stories always make us laugh.
options: My grandmother, who her stories always make us laugh, is a retired teacher.
My grandmother, that stories always make us laugh, is a retired teacher.
My grandmother, whose her stories always make us laugh, is a retired teacher.
My grandmother, whose stories always make us laugh, is a retired teacher.
items.explain_vi: ==Her stories== (sở hữu) → **whose stories**, không thêm 'her'. __Mệnh đề không xác định có dấu phẩy, không dùng 'that'.__

items.q: The sofa was too heavy for the two boys to move.
options: The sofa was such heavy that the two boys couldn't move it.
The sofa was so heavy that the two boys couldn't move it.
The sofa was so heavy that the two boys couldn't move.
The sofa wasn't heavy enough for the two boys to move.
items.explain_vi: ==too heavy for the two boys to move== → **so heavy that the two boys couldn't move it**: vế that cần tân ngữ 'it'. __such cần danh từ đi sau.__

items.q: I'm sure I locked the door. I clearly remember ______ it before I left.
items.explain_vi: Có ==I'm sure I locked the door== → nhớ việc ĐÃ làm: remember + V-ing → **locking**. __remember to V = nhớ phải làm (chưa làm).__

items.q: If Nam ______ more patient with his little brother, they wouldn't argue so often.
items.explain_vi: Có ==wouldn't argue== → điều kiện loại 2 (trái thực tế hiện tại): If + quá khứ, be dùng **were**. __Không dùng would trong mệnh đề If.__

items.q: After ten years of research, the team finally ______ a breakthrough in treating the disease.
items.explain_vi: Kết hợp từ **make a breakthrough** (tạo bước đột phá) → **made**. Dấu hiệu ==a breakthrough==. __Không nói do/take/get a breakthrough.__

items.q: Her grandfather had a great ______ on her decision to become a doctor.
items.explain_vi: Cụm **have an influence on** (ảnh hưởng tới) → **influence**. Dấu hiệu ==on her decision==. __impression đi với make; advice không dùng với 'a'.__

items.q: It took Hiền two weeks to ______ the flu, so she missed the school trip.
items.explain_vi: Có ==two weeks== và ==the flu== → khỏi bệnh: **get over**. __get up: thức dậy; get by: xoay xở; get off: xuống xe.__

items.q: Studying abroad helped Thảo become more ______: she learned to cook, clean and manage her money alone. (DEPEND)
items.explain_vi: Sau ==more== cần **tính từ**; ==alone== → nghĩa tự lập: in- + depend + -ent → **independent**. __Đọc ngữ cảnh để biết có cần tiền tố.__

items.q: What did the research with modern scanners show?
options: Only a small part of the brain works during the day.
Most of the brain is active, even during sleep.
The brain rests completely while we sleep.
Brain training games make people cleverer.
items.explain_vi: Bài đọc: ==almost every part of the brain is active … even while we are asleep== → **Most of the brain is active, even during sleep**. __Loại ý trái với bài.__

items.q: According to the passage, why do many people still believe the theory?
options: Scientists have not finished their research.
There is strong evidence to support it.
Brain scanners are too expensive to use.
It makes people feel they have hidden abilities.
items.explain_vi: Bài đọc: ==it tells us that we all have hidden talents== → **It makes people feel they have hidden abilities**. __talents ≈ abilities: đáp án hay dùng từ đồng nghĩa.__

items.q: We are all looking forward ______ our class trip to the zoo. (điền MỘT từ)
items.explain_vi: Cụm cố định **look forward to + danh từ / V-ing** → **to**. Dấu hiệu ==looking forward==. __Học cả cụm, đừng quên 'to'.__

items.q: My aunt is ______ artist. She paints beautiful pictures of old streets. (điền MỘT từ)
items.explain_vi: ==artist== là danh từ đếm được số ít, bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm → **an**. __Nói nghề nghiệp: be + a/an + nghề.__

items.q: The singer became ______ after her video got ten million views. (FAME)
items.explain_vi: Sau ==became== cần **tính từ**: fame bỏ e, thêm -ous → **famous**. __Đừng viết 'fameous'.__

items.q: The drama club is going to put ______ a short play at the end of the school year. (điền MỘT từ)
items.explain_vi: **put on** a play: dàn dựng buổi diễn → **on**. Dấu hiệu ==a short play==. __put on còn có nghĩa là mặc vào.__

items.q: Please turn off the TV. I need total ______ to finish this maths problem. (CONCENTRATE)
items.explain_vi: Sau tính từ ==total== cần **danh từ**: concentrate bỏ e, thêm -ion → **concentration**. __Động từ đuôi -ate thường thành danh từ -ation.__

items.q: The test was so easy that everyone passed it. → It was ______ everyone passed it.
items.explain_vi: Đáp án **such an easy test that** (such + a/an + tính từ + danh từ + that). ==easy== bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm → an. __such luôn cần danh từ.__

items.q: "I saw this film yesterday," said Lan. → Lan said she had seen that film the day ______. (điền MỘT từ)
items.explain_vi: Câu tường thuật đổi trạng từ thời gian: ==yesterday== → **the day before**. __Nhớ: tomorrow → the next day; today → that day.__

items.q: Their first two experiments were ______, but the third one finally worked. (SUCCESS)
items.explain_vi: Sau ==were== cần **tính từ**; vế ==but … finally worked== → nghĩa phủ định: un- + success + -ful → **unsuccessful**. __Vế sau 'but' gợi nghĩa trái.__

items.q: "I will send you the photos tomorrow," Hoa said to me. → Hoa told me ______.
items.answer: she would send me the photos the next day
accept: she would send me the photos the following day
she would send the photos to me the next day
she would send the photos to me the following day
she'd send me the photos the next day
she'd send me the photos the following day
she'd send the photos to me the next day
she'd send the photos to me the following day
that she would send me the photos the next day
that she would send me the photos the following day
that she would send the photos to me the next day
that she would send the photos to me the following day
that she'd send me the photos the next day
that she'd send me the photos the following day
that she'd send the photos to me the next day
that she'd send the photos to me the following day
items.explain_vi: Tường thuật với **told me**: will → **would**, I → she, you → me, ==tomorrow== → **the next day**. __Đổi cả thì, đại từ và trạng từ thời gian.__

items.q: Students must switch off all phones during the exam. → All phones ______ during the exam.
accept: must be turned off
have to be switched off
have to be turned off
items.explain_vi: Bị động với động từ khuyết thiếu: **must + be + V3** → **must be switched off**. Chủ ngữ mới ==All phones==. __Giữ nguyên must, thêm be.__

passages.text:
Hi Tùng,
I've got some news! In the summer I took up chess at our local club. Before that, I used to play games on my phone for hours, but now I meet real people every Wednesday. Next month there is a competition for beginners. I can't play in it yet, because you need a membership card first. Do you want to come and watch?
Khoa

Mr Tâm has sold phở from the same small stall near Đồng Xuân Market for thirty years. He gets up at three o'clock every morning to cook the broth, because he believes a good soup needs at least five hours. Customers often ask for his recipe, and he always gives the same answer: there is no secret ingredient, only patience. Last year his son wanted to open a modern restaurant with a menu in three languages. Mr Tâm agreed, but on one condition: the old stall must stay open too. He says tourists come for the flavour, but local people come for the conversations they have on the little plastic chairs outside.

Many children are told that eating carrots will help them see in the dark. The idea sounds scientific, but its origin is surprisingly unscientific. During the Second World War, British pilots suddenly became much better at finding enemy planes at night. The real reason was a new radar system, but the government did not want the enemy to discover it, so newspapers reported that the pilots ate huge amounts of carrots. Modern research shows that carrots do contain a vitamin that keeps our eyes healthy, and people who lack it may have trouble seeing at night. However, there is no evidence that extra carrots give a healthy person better vision than normal. The story survives, researchers say, because it is simple, memorable and useful to parents who want their children to eat vegetables.

items.q: Câu 16 trong đề gốc
items.explain_vi: ==I'll be able to get to college in ten minutes now== → **A (xe nhanh)**. __Mẹo:__ cô trả khá nhiều tiền nên không phải vì rẻ.

items.q: Câu 17 trong đề gốc
items.explain_vi: ==We're learning about mountains and rivers== → **B (địa lý)**. __Mẹo:__ anh thích khoa học hồi đi học nhưng sẽ ít cần đến.

items.q: Câu 18 trong đề gốc
items.explain_vi: ==Their lessons were over for the day== → **C (sân chơi trường học)**. __Mẹo:__ trẻ chạy nhảy nhanh dễ khiến nghĩ tới sân vận động.

items.q: Câu 19 trong đề gốc
items.explain_vi: ==It probably fell out of my bag== → **B (mất ví)**: không mua được vé, phải mượn tiền. __Mẹo:__ lịch khám mắt dễ gợi nhầm C (kính vỡ).

items.q: Câu 20 trong đề gốc
items.explain_vi: ==I wanted something green, and this is so comfortable!== → **A (quần áo)**. __Mẹo:__ trò chơi cờ bàn là việc làm sau đó.

items.q: Listen! Somebody ______ the piano in the flat upstairs.
items.explain_vi: Có ==Listen!== → việc đang diễn ra lúc nói → **is playing** (hiện tại tiếp diễn). __Mẹo: Look!, Listen!, now, at the moment báo hiệu thì tiếp diễn.__

items.q: Lan ______ the dishes when she dropped a plate and broke it.
items.explain_vi: Có ==when she dropped a plate== → việc đang diễn ra dùng **was washing**. __Việc dài: was/were + V-ing; việc xen vào: quá khứ đơn.__

items.q: Mr Hùng ______ our English teacher since last year.
items.explain_vi: Có ==since last year== → nay vẫn dạy → **has been** (hiện tại hoàn thành). __Bẫy: since + mốc quá khứ vẫn dùng hiện tại hoàn thành.__

items.q:
A: Oh no! I've forgotten my money for the bus.
B: ______
options: No problem. I lent you some.
No problem. I'll lend you some.
No problem. I lend you some.
No problem. I've lent you some.
items.explain_vi: B quyết định giúp ngay lúc nói → **will: I'll lend you some**. Dấu hiệu ==I've forgotten my money==. __Đề nghị giúp, quyết định tức thì → will + V.__

items.q: Before every exam, Linh ______ her notes with her best friend.
items.explain_vi: Có ==Before every exam== và ==her notes== → ôn lại ghi chép: **revises**. __concentrate phải đi với on; attend, encourage không hợp với notes.__

items.q: Don't ______ your old school books! The younger students can use them next year.
items.explain_vi: Có ==The younger students can use them== → đừng vứt bỏ: **throw away**. __Đọc câu sau chỗ trống để thấy lý do.__

items.q: Our class trip to Đà Lạt was great. Before we went home, I bought a jar of strawberry jam as a ______ for my grandparents. They were so happy.
items.explain_vi: Món đồ ==bought ... for my grandparents== trước khi về → **souvenir** (quà lưu niệm). __destination là điểm đến, không phải món quà.__

items.q: My little sister is very ______ with her toys, so they never break. (CARE)
items.explain_vi: Sau ==very== cần **tính từ**; ==they never break== → nghĩa tích cực: care + -ful → **careful**. __-ful = có, -less = không có.__

items.q: What did Khoa use to do before he took up chess?
options: go to the club every day
items.explain_vi: Bài đọc: ==I used to play games on my phone for hours== → **play games on his phone**. __used to = thói quen cũ, nay không còn.__

items.q: Why can't Khoa play in the competition yet?
options: The competition is only for adults.
He hasn't got a membership card.
items.explain_vi: Bài đọc: ==because you need a membership card first== → **He hasn't got a membership card**. __Câu hỏi Why → tìm 'because'.__

items.q: Passengers ______ use their phones while the plane is taking off. It's not allowed.
items.explain_vi: Có ==It's not allowed== → bị cấm: **mustn't**. __Bẫy: don't have to = không cần, không phải là cấm.__

items.q: The final was broadcast live on TV, and it was watch by millions of people.
items.explain_vi: Bị động cần **be + V3**: ==was watch== sửa thành **was watched**. __Bẫy: V3 của broadcast vẫn là broadcast nên 'was broadcast' đúng.__

items.q: I've got ______ good friends in my new class, so I don't feel lonely.
items.explain_vi: ==friends== đếm được số nhiều, ==so I don't feel lonely== → nghĩa tích cực: **a few**. __few (không có a) = rất ít, nghĩa tiêu cực.__

items.q: If it ______ this weekend, we'll have a picnic in the park.
items.explain_vi: Điều kiện loại 1: vế chính có ==we'll have== → vế If dùng hiện tại đơn: **doesn't rain**. __Không dùng will/won't trong mệnh đề If.__

items.q: Taking off your shoes before you enter someone's home is a CUSTOM in many Asian countries.
items.explain_vi: **custom** (tập quán) **≈ tradition** (truyền thống). ==in many Asian countries== → việc nhiều người cùng làm. __Bẫy: celebration là sự ăn mừng.__

items.q: My aunt is so GENEROUS that she always pays for everyone's ice cream.
items.explain_vi: **generous** (hào phóng) >< **mean** (keo kiệt). ==always pays for everyone's ice cream== là biểu hiện hào phóng. __Loại các từ gần nghĩa trước.__

items.q: It's hard for my parents to ______ all the new words that teenagers use online.
items.explain_vi: Có ==all the new words== → khó theo kịp cái mới: **keep up with**. __keep up with + tin tức, xu hướng = theo kịp.__

items.q: Our first rehearsal was a complete ______ because nobody remembered their lines. (FAIL)
items.explain_vi: Sau ==a complete== cần **danh từ**: fail + -ure → **failure** (sự thất bại). __-ure, -age, -ance biến động từ thành danh từ.__

items.q: Why does Mr Tâm get up at three o'clock every morning?
options: to buy fresh ingredients at the market
to cook the soup for many hours
items.explain_vi: Bài đọc: ==he believes a good soup needs at least five hours== → **to cook the soup for many hours**. __broth = nước dùng, tức là soup.__

items.q: According to Mr Tâm, what do local people like most about his stall?
options: the chance to chat with others
items.explain_vi: Bài đọc: ==local people come for the conversations== → **the chance to chat with others**. __Ý đứng sau 'but' thường là ý chính.__

items.q: Sa Pa is in the mountains of northern Việt Nam. My uncle runs a small hotel there.
options: Sa Pa, where my uncle runs a small hotel, is in the mountains of northern Việt Nam.
Sa Pa, which my uncle runs a small hotel, is in the mountains of northern Việt Nam.
Sa Pa, where my uncle runs a small hotel there, is in the mountains of northern Việt Nam.
Sa Pa, that my uncle runs a small hotel in, is in the mountains of northern Việt Nam.
items.explain_vi: ==there== (ở đó) → **where**, và bỏ 'there'. __Mệnh đề không xác định không dùng 'that'; which phải có giới từ (in which).__

items.q: This book is so difficult that I can't understand it.
options: This book is too difficult for me to understand it.
This book isn't difficult enough for me to understand.
This book is too difficult for me to understand.
This book is such difficult that I can't understand it.
items.explain_vi: ==so difficult that I can't understand it== → **too difficult for me to understand**: sau too … to V không lặp 'it'. __such cần danh từ đi sau.__

items.q: On the way to school, Minh stopped ______ some bread for breakfast.
items.explain_vi: Có ==On the way to school== → dừng lại ĐỂ mua: stop + to V → **to buy**. __stop + V-ing = ngừng hẳn việc đang làm.__

items.q: If the tickets ______ cheaper, we could take the whole class to the concert.
items.explain_vi: Có ==could take== → điều kiện loại 2: If + quá khứ đơn, be dùng **were**. __Không dùng will/would trong mệnh đề If.__

items.q: Scientists hope to ______ a breakthrough that will make solar panels much cheaper.
items.explain_vi: Kết hợp từ **make a breakthrough** → **make**. Dấu hiệu ==a breakthrough==. __Nhớ thêm: carry out research, do an experiment.__

items.q: Famous footballers have a strong ______ on the way young fans dress and behave.
items.explain_vi: Cụm **have an influence on** (ảnh hưởng tới) → **influence**. Dấu hiệu ==on the way young fans dress==. __impression đi với make; attention đi với pay.__

items.q: Our team was very upset after losing the final, but we ______ it quickly and started training again.
items.explain_vi: Có ==upset after losing the final== → vượt qua nỗi buồn: **got over**. __get over = khỏi bệnh hoặc vượt qua cú sốc.__

items.q: The smell from the rubbish bin was so ______ that we had to open all the windows. (PLEASE)
items.explain_vi: Sau ==so== cần **tính từ**; ==had to open all the windows== → nghĩa xấu: un- + please + -ant → **unpleasant**. __Bỏ e trước -ant.__

items.q: What does modern research show about carrots?
options: They help everyone see in the dark.
They were only useful for pilots.
They contain a vitamin that is good for the eyes.
They give healthy people better vision than normal.
items.explain_vi: Bài đọc: ==carrots do contain a vitamin that keeps our eyes healthy== → **They contain a vitamin that is good for the eyes**. __Câu sau phủ nhận 'better vision'.__

items.q: According to the passage, why do people still believe the story?
options: Scientists have proved that it is true.
It helps parents get their children to eat vegetables.
Pilots still eat carrots before flying at night.
items.explain_vi: Bài đọc: ==useful to parents who want their children to eat vegetables== → **It helps parents get their children to eat vegetables**. __Lý do đứng sau 'because'.__

items.q: My little brother is looking forward ______ his birthday party on Sunday. (điền MỘT từ)
items.explain_vi: Cụm cố định **look forward to + danh từ / V-ing** → **to**. Dấu hiệu ==looking forward==. __Học cả cụm, đừng quên 'to'.__

items.q: Hưng wants to be ______ engineer when he grows up. (điền MỘT từ)
items.explain_vi: ==engineer== là danh từ đếm được số ít, bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm → **an**. __Nói nghề nghiệp: be + a/an + nghề.__

items.q: We must protect the ______ beauty of Hạ Long Bay. (NATURE)
items.explain_vi: Trước danh từ ==beauty== cần **tính từ**: nature bỏ e, thêm -al → **natural**. __Tính từ đứng trước danh từ.__

items.q: Every December, the music club puts ______ a concert to raise money for charity. (điền MỘT từ)
items.explain_vi: **put on** a concert: tổ chức buổi biểu diễn → **on**. Dấu hiệu ==a concert==. __Nhớ: put on a show / an exhibition / a concert.__

items.q: Thanks to her teacher's ______, Mai entered the English speaking contest. (ENCOURAGE)
items.explain_vi: Sau sở hữu cách ==her teacher's== cần **danh từ**: encourage + -ment → **encouragement**. __Giữ nguyên e khi thêm -ment.__

items.q: The film was so exciting that we watched it twice. → It was ______ we watched it twice.
items.explain_vi: Đáp án **such an exciting film that** (such + a/an + tính từ + danh từ + that). ==exciting== bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm → an. __such luôn cần danh từ.__

items.q: "I'll return your book tomorrow," said Minh. → Minh said he would return my book the ______ day. (điền MỘT từ)
accept: following
items.explain_vi: Câu tường thuật đổi trạng từ thời gian: ==tomorrow== → **the next day** (hoặc the following day). __Nhớ: yesterday → the day before; now → then.__

items.q: The results were almost ______: nobody expected such a cheap material to work so well. (BELIEVE)
items.explain_vi: Sau ==almost== cần **tính từ**; ==nobody expected== → khó tin: un- + believe + -able (bỏ e) → **unbelievable**. __Tiền tố un- kết hợp hậu tố -able.__

items.q: "I am revising for my test now," Tuấn said to his mum. → Tuấn told his mum ______.
items.answer: he was revising for his test then
accept: he was revising for his test at that time
he was revising for his test at that moment
that he was revising for his test then
that he was revising for his test at that time
that he was revising for his test at that moment
items.explain_vi: Tường thuật: am revising → **was revising**, I/my → he/his, ==now== → **then**. __Đổi cả thì, đại từ và trạng từ thời gian.__

items.q: You should keep this medicine in a cool, dry place. → This medicine ______ in a cool, dry place.
items.explain_vi: Bị động với động từ khuyết thiếu: **should + be + V3**; keep → kept → **should be kept**. Chủ ngữ mới ==This medicine==. __Giữ nguyên should, thêm be.__
